function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 file within the selected workspace.

function.name: write_file
function.description: Create or replace a UTF-8 file within the selected workspace.

function.name: job_output
function.description: Read retained live or final background job output and status; optionally wait for completion.

function.name: job_list
function.description: List background jobs owned by this Agent.

function.name: job_kill
function.description: Request cancellation of one background job owned by this Agent.

function.name: send_message
function.description: Send a message to your direct continuable child, or to your direct parent when you are a resident continuable child. Running children receive steering at their nearest step; idle or closed children resume a turn. This returns delivery confirmation, independently of any answer.

function.name: interrupt_agent
function.description: Request cancellation of a live descendant's current turn. Unclaimed input remains parked until another send_message; owned descendants keep running. An absent target is an accepted no-op.

function.name: list_agents
function.description: List your continuable subagents by durable id and label. Status is running for current work, idle for a resident Agent between turns, and ready for a closed resumable Session. Descendants traverses ordinary Sessions and one-shot children in stable pre-order, adding parent and depth. Only direct children may receive send_message; deeper entries are interruption candidates. Listing grants no control permission. Unreadable children are diagnostics.

scope.description: children (default) or the complete descendant tree.

function.name: subagent
function.description: Delegate one task to a fresh child without your conversation. By default wait for its final result and cleanup. run_in_background returns after child readiness; use job_output/job_kill to observe or cancel the Agent-owned job.

function.name: fixture_wait_settlement
function.description: Wait for the actual child settlement notice in the parent inbox.

function.name: fixture_wait
function.description: Wait until the initiating Session is cancelled.

function.name: continuable_subagent
function.description: Delegate one task to a fresh child without your conversation. By default start a durable continuable child and return after its initial input is accepted. Use send_message for follow-ups and interrupt_agent to stop current work; run_in_background:false waits for a one-shot result.
